# Custom lab themes

## Concept

Any organization should be able to use the SWAPPS Design System with their own branding. The system does not hardcode SLAC-specific styling into shared components.

## What can be customized today

| Element | How |
|---|---|
| Organization name | `orgName` prop on AppHeader |
| Application title | `appTitle` prop on AppHeader |
| Logo | `logo` prop on AppHeader |
| Light/dark mode | Carbon `Theme` component |
| Navigation items | `navItems` prop on AppHeader |

## Example: Another laboratory

```tsx
import { AppHeader } from '@swapps/ui';
import { Theme } from '@carbon/react';

function BerkeleyLabApp() {
  return (
    <Theme theme="white">
      <AppHeader
        orgName="LBNL"
        appTitle="Detector Monitor"
        logo={<img src="/lbnl-logo.svg" alt="LBNL" height={20} />}
        navItems={[
          { label: 'Overview', href: '/' },
          { label: 'Detectors', href: '/detectors' },
        ]}
      />
      <main id="main-content">
        {/* Application content */}
      </main>
    </Theme>
  );
}
```

## Future: accent colors and token overrides

:::info Planned
Support for organization-specific accent colors and CSS custom property overrides is planned. This will allow labs to bring their brand colors into the UI without modifying components.

Sample colors used in documentation examples are illustrative only — they do not represent official colors of any organization.
:::
